purpose: Describe movement toward now or a change developing up to now.
keywords: It has started to get a little colder.
I will go and buy drinks and come back.
restrictions: It may express physical approach, a round trip, or a developing state.
mistake: Interpret the viewpoint from the surrounding sentence.
